description: This file defines the EasyHandle class within the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace. It represents a cURL easy handle, manages associated response and request data, and provides functionality to create a Response object from headers. The class is marked as internal and is part of the Guzzle HTTP client library's cURL handler implementation.

classes.name: EasyHandle
classes.description: Represents a cURL easy handle and associated data, providing mechanisms to manage HTTP request/response cycle within the Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a Response object based on the headers received for the current handle, parsing headers and normalizing them, also handling content encoding and content length adjustments.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to handle property access; throws an exception if an invalid property is accessed or if the handle has been released.
